-- brickwork with avail/available, apartment with avail/available/yes
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.housenum)
FROM households h
JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
JOIN amenities a ON a.houseid = h.housenum
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(h.locregion)) = 'guará'
  AND (
    (LOWER(TRIM(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) = 'brickwork house' 
     AND LOWER(TRIM(a.cablestatus)) IN ('avail', 'available'))
    OR
    (LOWER(TRIM(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) = 'apartment'
     AND LOWER(TRIM(a.cablestatus)) IN ('avail', 'available', 'yes'))
  );

-- Check for any household that matches BOTH brickwork+avail/available AND apartment+avail/available/yes
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT h.housenum
  FROM households h
  JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
  JOIN amenities a ON a.houseid = h.housenum
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(h.locregion)) = 'guará'
    AND (
      (LOWER(TRIM(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) = 'brickwork house' 
       AND LOWER(TRIM(a.cablestatus)) IN ('avail', 'available'))
      OR
      (LOWER(TRIM(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) = 'apartment'
       AND LOWER(TRIM(a.cablestatus)) IN ('avail', 'available', 'yes'))
    )
  GROUP BY h.housenum
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) sub;
